no_outcome_promised.note: The draft acknowledges the waiver request but neither promises nor confirms any outcome. The call note says the fee was already waived; whether to confirm that is the analyst's call.

no_liability_admitted.note: 'Sorry for the frustration this has caused' expresses empathy about the situation and does not say the bank made a mistake.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: The $12 fee, August, car repair and four-year history all come from the note. 'Below the minimum' is a generic stand-in for the tokenized threshold and does not guess its value. The only timeframe is the standard 10 business days.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance review, priority, internal guidelines or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no instructions aimed at an AI.

addresses_each_issue.note: Specifically restates the fee, the August balance dip, the car repair, the waiver request and the four-year tenure. It does not mention that the rep reports the matter resolved; the analyst may want to add that.

tone.note: Warm and plain. The apology for frustration reads slightly scripted given that the customer left the call satisfied, but it is not defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode: the draft names Deposit Operations as the owning team and gives the standard timeframe.
